dish.title: Brazilian Fish Moqueca
dish.description: Lime-and-garlic-marinated halibut layered with onion, red and yellow pepper rings, and tomato, then gently simmered in coconut milk with sweet paprika and olive oil until just flaky; finished with lime and cilantro and served over white rice. A Bahian-style coconut moqueca made with olive oil instead of dende. White fish only; no shrimp or shellfish.

recipe_version.title: Brazilian Fish Moqueca
recipe_version.description: Lime-and-garlic-marinated halibut layered with onion, red and yellow pepper rings, and tomato, then gently simmered in coconut milk with sweet paprika and olive oil until just flaky; finished with lime and cilantro and served over white rice. A Bahian-style coconut moqueca made with olive oil instead of dende. White fish only; no shrimp or shellfish.

ingredients.name: halibut fillet
ingredients.note: 1 to 1.5 inches thick. REQUIRED contract: firm white finfish only; cod or haddock may replace halibut one-for-one. NO shrimp, prawns, or any shellfish.

ingredients.name: limes
ingredients.note: 2 juiced (about 1/4 cup: 2 tbsp marinade, 2 tbsp finish), 1 cut into wedges for serving

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: 2 for the marinade, 3 for the base

ingredients.name: sweet paprika
ingredients.note: 1 tsp marinade, 1 tsp base; gives the broth its coral color in place of dende

ingredients.name: yellow onion
ingredients.note: large, about 12 oz; half for the base, half layered

ingredients.name: red bell pepper
ingredients.note: half for the base, half layered

ingredients.name: yellow bell pepper
ingredients.note: half for the base, half layered

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.note: one can. Contract: canned coconut milk (coconut and water, possibly guar gum). Not coconut-milk beverage, coffee creamer, or sweetened cream of coconut. Coconut is not a tree nut for this package policy.

ingredients.name: cilantro
ingredients.preparation: tender stems finely chopped (about 2 tbsp) for the base; leaves reserved to finish

ingredients.name: long-grain white rice
ingredients.preparation: rinsed until water runs mostly clear

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp for the base, 1 tbsp drizzled over the layers. Dende (red palm oil) is not used.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 3/4 tsp fish, 1/2 tsp base, 1/2 tsp coconut milk, 3/4 tsp rice

steps.title: Marinate the fish
steps.body: Pat the halibut dry and cut into 2-inch pieces. Toss in a bowl with 2 tbsp lime juice, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 tsp paprika, 3/4 tsp salt, and the black pepper. Let it marinate while you prep, about 15 minutes (no longer than 30, or the lime starts to firm the fish). HARD CONTRACT: white finfish only; no shrimp or any shellfish.

steps.title: Prep the vegetables and rice
steps.body: Slice the onion, red pepper, and yellow pepper into thin rings and the tomatoes into 1/4-inch rounds. Thinly slice the chile. Mince the remaining 3 garlic cloves. Finely chop 2 tbsp cilantro stems and pick the leaves. Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear. Cut the third lime into wedges. Shake and whisk the coconut milk smooth with 1/2 tsp salt.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: In a 2-quart saucepan bring the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 3/4 tsp salt to a boil over high (about 4 minutes). Cover, reduce to low, and cook 15 minutes; then leave it covered off the heat until serving (at least 5 minutes). This is set-and-forget and runs during steps 4 to 7 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Build the base
steps.body: At the same time, heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a 12-inch braiser or wide 5-quart Dutch oven over medium. Add half the onion, half of each pepper, the 3 cloves garlic, the cilantro stems, 1 tsp paprika, and 1/2 tsp salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. Spread in an even layer.

steps.title: Layer
steps.body: Lay half the tomato slices over the base. Nestle the fish in a single layer and pour over any marinade. Top with the remaining onion, pepper rings, tomatoes, and chile. Pour the coconut milk evenly over everything and drizzle with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil.

steps.title: Simmer gently
steps.body: Bring to a gentle simmer over medium, about 4 minutes (small bubbles at the edges). Cover, reduce to medium-low, and simmer without stirring 10 to 12 minutes, tilting the pan and spooning broth over the top once halfway, until the fish is opaque and flakes at the thickest part (145°F) and the peppers are tender but still hold their rings.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.body: Off heat, sprinkle with the remaining 2 tbsp lime juice, taste the broth for salt, and scatter the cilantro leaves. Serve in shallow bowls with the rice and lime wedges. No shrimp, no dende, no dairy. kitchen_tested is false.

equipment: 12-inch braiser or wide 5-quart Dutch oven with lid
recipe_version.heat: Medium sauté, then gentle covered simmer at medium-low. Rice on high then low. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Fish opaque and flaking at the thickest part (145°F), still moist. Peppers tender with rings intact. Broth creamy, coral-colored, and bright with lime. Rice fluffy. kitchen_tested is false.
